question: Owner's idea (2026-10-26): every player is always on the pitch, so a detected player can be followed through the detector's misses. Offline stitching of the pipeline's tracklets per team, gaps filled in pitch metres.
status: exploratory, CPU, written before any run
units: the M7 (128057) and M9 (132831) shots clips (27), their v3s_link pitch tracks; truth through src/unseal.py
stitching: per team (team_A / team_B; 'other' left out), tracklet ends linked to later tracklet starts by one assignment (Hungarian): feasible if the gap <= 5 s and the distance <= 2 m + 8 m/s x gap; cost = distance + 0.5 x gap (s); chains get a slot id; gaps filled linearly at the players' frames

metrics (truth: players and goalkeepers,.coverage: truth persons with a position of their team within 3 m (before: detections; after: detections + fills)
metrics (truth: players and goalkeepers,.fill precision: filled positions within 3 m of a truth person of the same side
metrics (truth: players and goalkeepers,.identity continuity: per truth person, the share of its matched frames on its most frequent track (before) / slot (after)
metrics (truth: players and goalkeepers,.who made the action: rule C (src/passer.actor) on the stitched tracks vs the original ones, the actor's position matched to the truth in pitch metres (3 m) for both, actions inside the ball range

worth pursuing if: M9 coverage +10 points or more with fill precision >= 0.80, and C's share right not lower
